objects.description: [ZeroCleare](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1151) has used a vulnerable signed VBoxDrv driver to bypass Microsoft Driver Signature Enforcement (DSE) protections and subsequently load the unsigned [RawDisk](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0364) driver.(Citation: IBM ZeroCleare Wiper December 2019)
objects.description_fa: [ZeroCleare](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1151) از یک درایور آسیب‌پذیر امضاشده VBoxDrv برای دور زدن حفاظت‌های Microsoft Driver Signature Enforcement (DSE) و متعاقباً بارگیری [RawDisk] ([[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]]VE_0]TI] بدون علامت [RawDisk] استفاده کرده است. (Citation: IBM ZeroCleare Wiper December 2019) https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0364
